description: Structured public decision record. Source text, excerpts, quotations, OCR output, and private notes are forbidden.

completion_rules.pending: All decision and evidence values remain null.
completion_rules.in-review: Private workspace may contain notes, while the public worklist remains unapplied.
completion_rules.reviewed: Selected decision must belong to the inspection item's decision options and all lane evidence requirements must be present.
completion_rules.unresolved: Selected decision must equal unresolved and required source-page evidence must be present.
